title: Affine Left--Right Dirac Data on the Moyal Plane, with an Application to $U(1)_\star$ Gauge Coupling in Noncommutative Quantum Mechanics
summary: We study even non-unital Dirac data on the two-dimensional Moyal plane with fixed deformation parameter \(\vartheta\neq0\), whose Dirac operator is affine in the left and right regular coordinate multipliers, with coefficient matrices \(T_L\) and \(T_R\). Two invariants organize this class. The right block controls algebra--Dirac transversality: local compactness holds if and only if \(\det T_R\neq0\), with \(|\det T_R|\) determining the local volume coefficient and \(\operatorname{sgn}\det T_R\) the oriented Gaussian \(K\)-homology pairing. Independently, \(Γ=\vartheta(\det T_L-\det T_R)\)…
